summary: Iteration 53: DEAL Integration Testing. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All DEAL features verified - send-order, webhook, orders, commissions endpoints working. ProductDetailPage shows 'Comprar' for DEAL products, 'Solicitar Servicio' for DEAL services, 'Agregar' for non-DEAL. NewProductPage DEAL toggle section with partner_id and referral_code fields working. Confirmation modal displays correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend deal_integration.py: All endpoints properly implemented - send-order creates local order and forwards to DEAL API (gracefully handles missing DEAL_API_URL), webhook updates order status/registers commission/activates service
Backend marketplace.py: ProductCreate/ProductUpdate models include deal_enabled, deal_partner_id, deal_referral_code fields

Frontend ProductDetailPage.jsx lines 413-440: Correctly shows DEAL button only for other sellers' products with deal_enabled=true, shows 'Solicitar Servicio' for services category, 'Comprar' for others
Frontend NewProductPage.jsx lines 499-547: DEAL integration section with green border, Zap icon, toggle, and conditional partner_id/referral_code inputs
DEAL_API_URL is empty in .env (placeholder) - orders stored locally with deal_id=null, which is expected behavior per agent_to_agent_context_note
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test products for UI testing: 1) DEAL Product From Other Seller (id: 6c43347e-9cb5-4a8b-9cca-abaaf667ed9b) - electronics category, 2) DEAL Service From Other Seller (id: c56b2e01-3bcd-4cca-bbef-6da95d78df4b) - services category
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 verified DEAL integration. Key findings: 1) POST /api/deal/send-order creates order with status 'pending_payment', deal_id is null when DEAL_API_URL not configured. 2) POST /api/deal/webhook updates order status, registers commission in deal_commissions collection, creates activation in deal_activations collection. 3) GET /api/deal/orders returns user's orders sorted by created_at desc. 4) GET /api/deal/commissions returns partner commissions. 5) ProductDetailPage shows green 'Comprar' button (data-testid='deal-purchase-btn') for DEAL products, 'Solicitar Servicio' for services. 6) NewProductPage has DEAL section (data-testid='deal-integration-section') with toggle (data-testid='deal-enabled-toggle'), partner_id input (data-testid='deal-partner-id-input'), referral_code input (data-testid='deal-referral-code-input'). 7) Confirmation modal (data-testid='deal-order-confirmation') shows order details with 'Entendido' close button (data-testid='deal-order-close-btn').

deal_send_order_endpoint.details: POST /api/deal/send-order creates order with all required fields (cliente, producto, precio, partner_id, referral_code, origen: Bruno, estado: pending_payment)

deal_webhook_endpoint.details: POST /api/deal/webhook receives payment confirmation, updates order status, registers commission, activates service

deal_orders_endpoint.details: GET /api/deal/orders returns user's orders, GET /api/deal/orders/{id} returns specific order

webhook_signature_verification.details: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification implemented, skipped when DEAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET not configured

marketplace_deal_enabled_field.details: POST /api/marketplace/products accepts deal_enabled, deal_partner_id, deal_referral_code fields

product_detail_deal_button.details: ProductDetailPage shows 'Comprar' for DEAL products, 'Solicitar Servicio' for DEAL services

product_detail_standard_button.details: ProductDetailPage shows 'Agregar' cart button for non-DEAL products

new_product_deal_toggle.details: NewProductPage has DEAL toggle section with partner_id and referral_code fields that appear when enabled

deal_order_confirmation_modal.details: Confirmation modal shows order details (product name, total, status, order ID) with 'Entendido' close button

mocked_apis.DEAL_API: DEAL external API URL is not configured (empty in .env). Orders are stored locally with deal_id=null. This is expected behavior - the webhook endpoint is fully functional for receiving payment confirmations.
